pages.title: Portal Block
pages.text: After crafting the $(item)Highly Irradiated Magical Core$() and conjuring the $(item)Bones of the Damned$() in the $(item)Slate Ossuary$() you will be able to complete the portal block leading into the next Simulation.

pages.title: Portal Activator
pages.text: Lighting the $(item)Portal$() to the fifth $(item)Simulation$() requires you to hold a $(item)Midnight Idol$().
